description: Defines the journeys the agent operates across. The pipeline in CLAUDE.md is journey-agnostic — it reads whatever journeys are listed here, so a later round can add a new journey (e.g. dealer_onboarding, complaint_triage) without changing the pipeline logic, only this file plus any new signal types in customer_signal_taxonomy.json.

journeys.name: Test-Drive Warm-End Conversion
journeys.case_grounding: 62% of test-drivers never book (6.5 lakh/yr); test-drivers are the most expensive prospects Asteron owns, already carried through 5 funnel stages.
journeys.entry_criteria: test drive completed, no booking recorded within the timing window
journeys.act_description: Package the context pack and hand off to a human sales consultant, who owns the conversation, price, exchange, and close. The agent never negotiates or closes.

journeys.name: Service Reactivation
journeys.case_grounding: Only 46% of customers still service at authorized workshops by year 3; service and parts are 52% of dealer operating profit — this is the pool Asteron owns outright, no dealer boundary to negotiate.
journeys.entry_criteria: customer past the expected service-due interval, or lapsed from the authorized service network
journeys.act_description: Execute pre-approved low-risk actions (service reminders, scheduling nudges, status updates) directly, or augment with a context pack for a human service advisor when the record touches a human-only category (e.g. a prior unresolved complaint).

extensibility_note: To add a journey for a later round: add an entry here with entry_criteria, timing window, act_step_name/description and target_metric; add any new signal codes it needs to customer_signal_taxonomy.json; add any new human-only categories it touches to decision_boundaries.json. CLAUDE.md's pipeline steps do not need to change.
